_comment: AI spending limits for automated testing campaigns (estimated USD from reported tokens at list price). Raising a limit requires the 'authorization' block: who approved it, when, the new limits and why. Without it the defaults below apply. Production imports are not governed by this file.

A.note: Offline replay. No model request is possible (AI_MODE=offline, Level A guard).

B.note: Targeted live listing extraction. Runs the discovery engine directly with AI fallbacks disabled; never builds an app.

C.note: Targeted real-AI checks of AI-dependent behaviour only.

D.note: Full end-to-end builds. Milestones and release gates only; needs a written justification.
